quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric press release: Mitsubishi Electric Develops Industry's First Machining (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mitsubishi Electric developed what it calls the industry's first machining system in which humanoid robots and CNC machine tools collaborate through physical AI (an AI machining task planner taking natural-language instructions, a CNC machine tool with physical AI built on its Maisart technology, and a general-purpose humanoid robot), aimed at unmanned machining; it is a development to be shown as a demonstration at JIMTOF 2026 from October 26, 2026, with no commercial release date stated.
